info.title: Threadly API
info.description:
The Threadly backend: accounts, roles, the wardrobe, photos and the member profile.

**How to log in here**
1. `POST /auth/login` (Try it out) with your email and password. Copy the `accessToken` from the answer.
2. Click **Authorize** (top right), paste the token in **bearerAuth**, then **Authorize** and **Close**.
3. Every route with a lock now sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token works for 15 minutes.

The refresh token is never in an answer body: it travels in the httpOnly cookie `refreshToken` (path `/auth`). The browser keeps it after a login here and sends it to `/auth/refresh`, `/auth/logout` and `/auth/logout-others` by itself.

**Answers for every route**
- An answer with an error is always `{ "message": "..." }`.
- Broken JSON in the body: **400** `bad request`.
- An unknown address: **404** `route not found`.
- An unexpected error: **500** `something went wrong` (the details stay in the server log).

**Permissions.** A route marked *Permission: `x`* runs `requireAuth`, then `requirePermission("x")`. The field `x-permission` says the same for tools. Which role has which permission is in the README.

post.description: Guards: `registerLimiter` (5 per hour per IP). No login needed. The new user is a `member`.

400.description: The email or the password does not follow the rules

example.message: the email must be valid and the password needs at least 8 characters , with a letter and a number
user with this email already exists
too many register attempts , please try again after a while

post.description: Guards: `loginLimiter` (6 per minute per IP). Gives an access token (15 minutes) in the body and a refresh token (7 days) in the httpOnly cookie `refreshToken`. Every login failure gets the SAME answer, so nobody learns which emails exist.

400.description: The email is not an email, or the password is empty

401.description: Wrong email, wrong password, or an account that is switched off

example.message: too many login attempts , please try again after a minute

200.description: The logged-in user (never the password hash)

post.summary: Swap the refresh cookie for a new access token
post.description: Guards: `RefreshLimiter` (10 per minute per IP). Needs the cookie `refreshToken` (the browser sends it by itself after a login). The cookie is used once and replaced by a new one (rotation). Showing an old cookie again cancels the whole family of tokens.

200.description: A new access token, and a new cookie

401.description: No cookie, or a cookie that is unknown, used, expired, cancelled, or of a user switched off

example.message: too many refresh attempts , please try again after a minute

post.description: Guards: none. Cancels this device's refresh token (if the cookie is there) and clears the cookie. Always answers 200.
Guards: `logoutOthersLimiter` (5 per 15 minutes), `requireAuth`. Needs the access token AND this device's cookie `refreshToken`: this device stays logged in.

200.description: The other devices are logged out

401.description: No token or a bad token (requireAuth), or no cookie, or a cookie that is unknown or of another user

example.message: too many logout attempts , please try again after 15 minutes

post.description: Guards: `changePasswordLimiter` (5 per 15 minutes), `requireAuth`. Ends every session: all refresh tokens are cancelled and the cookie is cleared. An access token already given still works until it expires.

example.message: password changed, please log in again

401.description: Not logged in, or the current password is wrong

value.message: you need to log in again

example.message: too many change password attempts , please try again after 15 minutes

post.description: Guards: `deactivateLimiter` (5 per 15 minutes), `requireAuth`. Every refresh token is cancelled and the cookie is cleared.

401.description: Not logged in, or the password is wrong

example.message: too many deactivate attempts , please try again after 15 minutes

get.description: Guards: `requireAuth`. If I have no profile yet, the answer is the empty default and nothing is written.

patch.description: Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`. Send only the fields to change. `""` clears a text field, `[]` clears favoriteColors. Unknown keys (like userId) are dropped.

400.description: A field breaks the rules, or there is nothing to change

post.description: Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, then `receiveImage` (multer, LAST, so an anonymous person cannot send a big file). The old avatar file is removed only after the new one is saved. The answer is the whole profile with a fresh `avatarUrl`.

delete.description: Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`. The file is removed from the image storage FIRST, then from the profile. If the storage fails, the profile keeps its avatar.

get.description:
Guards: `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("user:view")`. Newest first, at most 50 per page, never the password hash.

Permission: `user:view`

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: A part of the email (no difference between capitals and small letters)

patch.summary: Switch a user on or off
patch.description:
Guards: `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("user:ban")`. A user switched off loses every login. Written in the audit log.

Permission: `user:ban`

400.description: A bad body or id, or a change that is never allowed

value.message: you cannot switch off your own account
there must be at least one superadmin

patch.description:
Guards: `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("role:assign")`. Nobody can change their own role; only a superadmin can give, take or change the superadmin role; the last active superadmin stays. Written in the audit log.

Permission: `role:assign`

400.description: A bad body, id or role, or a change that is never allowed

value.message: you cannot change your own role
there must be at least one superadmin

get.description:
Guards: `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("audit:view")`. Newest first, at most 50 per page.

Permission: `audit:view`

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only the rows of this action, like `role.assign`

get.summary: List every role with its permissions

put.summary: Replace the permission list of a role
put.description:
Guards: `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("permission:edit")`. The whole list is replaced; the same name twice counts once. The superadmin role always keeps `role:assign` and `permission:edit`. Works at the next request. Written in the audit log.

Permission: `permission:edit`

400.description: A bad body, an unknown permission name, or superadmin would lose a key permission

value.message: superadmin must keep role:assign and permission:edit

post.summary: Add an item to my wardrobe
post.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`. The owner comes from the token. ownerId, status, wearCount, lastWornAt and isDeleted are never taken from the body (unknown keys are dropped).

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

get.description:
Guards: `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`. Only my items, newest first, at most 50 per page. Deleted items never appear. The filters can be combined.

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: One color from the `colors` list (compared in lowercase)

parameters.name: styleTag
parameters.description: One tag from the `styleTags` list (compared in lowercase)

parameters.name: notWornDays
parameters.description: Not worn for that many days, or never worn

get.description:
Guards: `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy (the owner only).

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

patch.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy. Send only the fields to change. `""` clears a text or a choice, `[]` clears a list, `null` clears the price. `{}` answers "nothing to change".

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

400.description: A field breaks the rules, nothing to change, or a bad id

delete.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy. The item stays in the database, marked as deleted; every route then answers 404 for it.

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

patch.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy. status becomes `archived`. Repeating it is fine (200).

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

patch.summary: Put my item back in the closet
patch.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy. status becomes `in_closet`. Repeating it is fine (200).

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

post.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy. wearCount + 1, lastWornAt now.

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

post.summary: Upload a photo of my item
post.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then `receiveImage` (multer, LAST), then the item policy. One file in the field `image`, at most 5 MB, JPEG, PNG or WebP (decided by the real content of the file, never by its name). At most 5 photos per item. The file goes to the storage first: if that fails, nothing is saved.

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

400.description: No file, two files, a bad form, a bad alt, or a bad id

value.message: only one image at a time

get.summary: List the photos of my item
get.description:
Guards: `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy. Newest first, each with a fresh signed `url` (left out if signing failed).

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

patch.summary: Change the alt of a photo
patch.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy. Only `alt` can change; `""` clears it; `{}` answers "nothing to change".

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

400.description: A bad alt, nothing to change, or a bad id

delete.description:
Guards: `writeLimiter`, `requireAuth`, `requirePermission("wardrobe:manage_own")`, then the item policy. The file is deleted from the storage FIRST, then the row. If the storage fails, the row stays, so the owner can try again.

Permission: `wardrobe:manage_own`

refreshCookie.name: refreshToken
refreshCookie.description: The httpOnly refresh cookie (7 days, path `/auth`). It is set by `POST /auth/login` and the browser sends it by itself: there is nothing to paste here.

RefreshCookie.description: `refreshToken=<new token>; Path=/auth; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=604800` (plus `Secure` in production)

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Rows per page. More than 50 is cut to 50

ItemId.name: id
ItemId.description: The id of my wardrobe item (24 hex characters)

ImageId.name: imageId
ImageId.description: The id of a photo of that item (24 hex characters)

UserId.name: id
UserId.description: The id of the user (24 hex characters)

NotLoggedIn.description: requireAuth: no token, or a token that is wrong, expired, or of a user switched off

NotAllowed.description: requirePermission: my role does not have the permission

NotAllowedOrSuperadmin.description: My role does not have the permission, or the change touches a superadmin and I am not one

value.message: only a superadmin can change a superadmin

InvalidId.description: An id that is not a MongoDB id

ItemNotFound.description: No such item, someone else's item, or a deleted item (a stranger always gets this, never 403)

ItemOrImageNotFound.description: The item is not mine (or does not exist), or the photo is not on that item

TooManyChanges.description: writeLimiter: 60 changes per 15 minutes per IP, for the wardrobe and profile together

example.message: too many changes , please try again after 15 minutes

BadUpload.description: No file, two files, or a bad form

value.message: only one image at a time

ImageTooLarge.description: The file is bigger than 5 MB

WrongImageType.description: The content of the file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP

example.message: only jpeg, png or webp images

StorageFailed.description: The image storage said no or could not be reached (for example a paused Supabase project)

StorageNotSetUp.description: A SUPABASE_ setting is missing or not valid

example.message: image storage is not set up

ImageAnswer.description: The photo, with a fresh signed url

password.description: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number

newPassword.description: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number

ProfileInput.description: Every field is optional. "" clears a text field.

favoriteColors.description: Trimmed and saved in lowercase. [] clears the list

Profile.description: Text fields only when they have a value. sizes is always an object, styles and favoriteColors always lists. Never _id, __v or avatarStoragePath.

avatarUrl.description: A signed link to my avatar, valid 1 hour. Left out when I have none, or when signing failed

image.description: One JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB

role.description: The name of a role that exists

permissions.description: The WHOLE new list. Every name must be a real permission

ItemStatus.description: Only the archive and restore routes change it. listed and sold are for the marketplace (later)

ItemFields.description: Every field is optional. "" clears a text or a choice, [] clears a list, null clears the price. Unknown keys are dropped.

Item.description: Never __v, isDeleted or deletedAt. colors and styleTags are always lists.

coverUrl.description: A signed link to the oldest original photo, valid 1 hour. Left out when there is no photo, or when signing failed

image.description: One JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB

alt.description: A short text that describes the photo

url.description: A signed link, valid 1 hour. Left out when signing failed
